G.A.M.E. B.R.I.D.G.E.

User Manual — a short guide to the GameBridge interface and its everyday controls.

v1.1

Getting started

1. Choose your AISelect the AI model you want to use.
2. Choose an adapterSelect the application you want GameBridge to work with.
3. ConnectUse Launch / Attach App to start or connect to the selected application.
4. Enable what you needTurn on AI, voice, Internet AI, or the required channel controls.
5. ChatType a message and press Send, or use the available voice controls.

Main window

Main GameBridge interface — markers 1–19.
#ControlWhat it does
1 Status & main switches Shows the current status indicator and controls AI Active, Internet AI, and Memory.
2 AI model Select the AI model GameBridge should use.
3 Adapter Select the application adapter you want to use.
4 Launch / Attach App Starts or attaches the selected application. When connected, the button changes to Disconnect.
5 User Channels Controls the user side of Channel 1 and user voice input.
6 Voice controls Choose voice mode and control user/AI voice operation. Voice modes are OFF, PTT, and LISTEN.
7 AI Channels Controls AI voice, AI Channel 1 presentation, telemetry, and Channel 2 interaction.
8 Chat / presentation The main area for conversation, status messages, and optional monitored information. The displayed background image can be replaced.
9 Text input Enter a message manually.
10 Send Sends the text entered in the message field.
11 Stay on Top Keeps the GameBridge window above other windows.
12 Text Size Switches between the normal and larger chat text size.
13 Text Color Opens the text-color selector for the chat presentation.
14 Monitor Shows or hides the monitor presentation area.
15 Settings Opens the GameBridge settings window.
16 PTT hotkey Click to capture/change the keyboard key used for push-to-talk.
17 Reset Returns the active GameBridge session toward its default state.
18 Keyboard/input control Controls the keyboard/input lock state.
19 Lock status Shows whether the keyboard/input control is locked or unlocked.
About the chat image: the large image shown behind the chat text is replaceable. You can use your own background image to give the presentation area a different look.

Settings

Settings window — markers 20–26. The Close button needs no marker.
#SettingWhat it does
20 Language Selects the GameBridge interface language.
21 AI Provider Selects the AI provider. The model itself is selected separately in the main window.
22 Internet Provider Selects the provider used when Internet AI is enabled.
23 TTS Provider Selects the text-to-speech provider.
24 Voice Selects the voice supplied by the selected TTS provider.
25 Monitor Channel 2 Controls whether Channel 2 traffic is shown in the monitor presentation.
26 Monitor Telemetry Controls whether telemetry is shown in the monitor presentation.

Channels and voice — quick reference

Channel 1The normal conversation channel used for human and AI messages.
VoiceUse OFF, PTT, or LISTEN together with the user/AI voice controls.
TelemetryAllows application information to be presented when supported by the connected adapter.
Channel 2Used for interaction with the connected application when supported by its adapter.

Useful tips

  • If no adapter is loaded, select one before trying to connect an application.
  • Use Stay on Top when you want GameBridge visible while working in another application.
  • Use Text Size and Text Color to make the chat presentation easier to read.
  • The Settings window controls language, providers, voice selection, and monitor presentation.
